ModMetaData.name: Hearth & Harbor – Guests, Hotels & Hospitality
ModMetaData.author: juliusberger00
ModMetaData.description:
Main Mod. Turn your colony into a host: guests, inns and hotels, shops and restaurants, a casino, spa, city life, a discreet back room – and Silverline, a full bank with accounts, loans and insurance, built in.
Nothing is forced on you: until you mark a guest bed or put up a sign, the game plays like vanilla.
Hearth & Harbor already includes Silverline. You do not need the separate bank mod.
